job_spec.name: qkd_ctrl_pc_core_s6w-s6w-68b332b72
job_spec.purpose: KVCTRL split 2026-10-16 (Codex-prescribed, no third same-shape retry, no waiver): e1 one HBM root 17,150 sinks at measured insertion 426.8 ps (>300 rule) and e2 plateaued at native_commit_identity -58.453 ps. qkd_ctrl_pc_host_static becomes a wires-parent of three hardened roots: core (scheduler/tags/CDC/observer/drain, ~13.3k hclk sinks est), port (actual ot_qfd_emb_pcport KVW2/RQD64 + its data pin flops, ~2.9k), ECC (actual ot_qfd_kv_landing_ecc, ~0.9k). Every seam output flop-driven; priced edges: native commit +1 hclk (new pin register; SDC moves native_commit_* to the hclk domain), static write data +1 hclk into the port (hidden, column >= 4 edges later), KV read/write 0. s4 (lead 2026-10-16, parallel to core_s1's hold ECO): STRUCTURAL fixes of the two measured core limiters. (1) e_l_v is captured in a pin flop l_v_q (core_s1 routed TT in->reg -30.92; gate textbook 13-level e_l_v -> drain_kv cone): drain_kv counts the ECC landing one hclk edge later (debt held longer, never early; raw e_l_v kept in the activity veto), traffic 0 edges, drain observation <= +1 hclk (already conservative, DRAIN_PIPE). (2) ot_qkd_static_kv_timing write-queue next head: per-entry bank one-hot stored at push + registered wq_rp1, both head candidates read in parallel and the late wr_ok selects last (was wr_ok -> wq_rp+1 -> 4:1 read -> 5:32 decode, 18 levels, ~772 ps): cycle-identical, 0 edges. cycles_added 0 (traffic/data); drain observation +1 hclk. (3) core_s1's routed TT reg->reg limiter was wq_rp -> wq_bq -> hold_n -> s_pre_ok -> s_pblk -> rd_ok -> rd_oh (-20.54 TT, 24 levels; SS -525.84): hold_n is now the OR of stored per-entry one-hots under per-SLOT valid bits (order-free set, identical value), no wq_rp-relative index/decode. (4) outline 97.2 -> 108.0 x 216 (util ~53% -> ~48%): core_s1's hold ECO needed ~11.4k hold cells (13,600 FF endpoints in margin) and the routed layout had a dense W pin band; the parent c1 grows to 207.36 wide (slot 247.512). (5) ECC head lookahead e_sec/e_row <= f(tq[tr + kv_v]): both candidates f(tq[tr]), f(tq[tr1]) (tr1 registered) formed in parallel, p_kv_v selects last (core_s1 p_kv_v -> e_sec 13 levels, met only after LVT): identical values, 0 edges. s5 (lead, parallel to s4): (6) idle split, cycle-identical: idle_core_r registers the idle AND without the raw es[0] pin, a dedicated (keep) es[0] pin flop es0_idle_q, idle_core = idle_core_r & !es0_idle_q (AND2 of two flops; core_s4 gate es[0] -> idle_core in->reg -34.9 ps). s_pblk arbitration (sb -> hb_oh 15 lv, ~648 ps est) NOT split: s_pblk depends on the combinational row decision r_v/r_sp, no cheap cycle-identical cut. s6 (KVCTRL 1815, structural fix of core_s5 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD at 4_1_cts): the one endpoint the hold repair could not fix (WNS stuck -17.17 ps for 8,660 iterations while 10,955 margin buffers went in) was l_v_q/D, the e_l_v pin flop: the e_l_v port also fed the combinational hbm_drain_activity OR, so leaf_inhold gave it NO input hold pad (it skips ports with non-DFF loads) and the port-net buffer was rejected. (7) raw e_l_v and es[0] leave the activity vetoes; each now loads only pin flops (padded like every other input). Cycle-identical: es_v_q / l_v (one edge later) are in the vetoes and a legal landing always has drain_kv >= 1, so hbm_debt_zero_q vetoes the same edges; measured: production j0/j8/j16/late_tail drain logs incl. a per-transition idle_core/idle_hbm/drain_fault trace and controller_calendar_native run0/8/16 IDENTICAL to s5. cycles_added 0. s6w: same RTL, outline 108.0 -> 116.64 x 216 (lower density for the ~13.5k-endpoint FF hold-margin fill, ~16k buffers predicted).
